section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: 21 Incidence of Suicides in States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities The incidence of suicides for the States as a whole recorded an increase of 12.9 per cent in 1974 over 1973. Out of 21 States, 12 States recorded an increase in the incidence of suicide during 1974 over 1973 and 9 States registered a decrease. Meghalaya recorded the maximum increase (375.0 per cent) followed by Punjab (191.3 per cent), Madhya Pradesh (92.7 per cent), Nagaland (80.0 per cent) and West Bengal (35.4 per cent). The percentage increase for other seven States was between 24.7 to 1.2 per cent. The States which recorded decline were Jammu & Kashmir (95.0 per cent), Himachal Pradesh (43.7 per cent), Bihar (16.6 per cent), Manipur (15.4 per cent), Kerala (9.9 per cent), Uttar Pradesh (9.0 per cent), Karnataka (8.0 per cent), Gujarat (7.0 per cent) and Haryana (5.0 per cent).
